analogue: Cross-termination of α-pinene- and isoprene-derived gas-phase peroxy radicals giving C14–15 products at the expense of C19–20 monoterpene dimers.
citation: Molecular understanding of the suppression of new-particle formation by isoprene
evidence: CLOUD experiments measured a shift from C19–20 toward C14–15 dimers and suppressed early particle formation upon adding isoprene, consistent with mixed RO₂ termination.
difference: The C14–15 products can still participate in growth. Treating all material as permanently volatile F_AI is a model end member; Manchester NOx, loading, and suspended seed differ.
